// GENERATED by packages/elements/scripts/write-loader.mjs from the component
// inventory: never edit by hand.
//
// Registers each ki-* component the first time the page shows it, from the
// module its `@kimen/elements/<tag>` subpath publishes. One static import()
// per tag lets every bundler emit one chunk per component.
const modules = {
  /* MODULES */
};

let nonce;
let runtime;
const loadRuntime = () =>
  import('../dist/components/stencil-client.js').then((module) => {
    runtime = module;
    if (nonce !== undefined) module./* NONCE */(nonce);
    return module;
  });

export function setNonce(value) {
  nonce = value;
  runtime?./* NONCE */(value);
}

const definitions = new Map();
function define(tag) {
  let definition = definitions.get(tag);
  if (definition === undefined) {
    definition = Promise.all([loadRuntime(), modules[tag]()]).then(
      ([, module]) => module.defineCustomElement(),
      (error) => {
        definitions.delete(tag);
        throw error;
      },
    );
    definitions.set(tag, definition);
  }
  return definition;
}

let excluded = new Set();
let observer;
const observed = new WeakSet();
const known = (element) =>
  Object.hasOwn(modules, element.localName) && !excluded.has(element.localName);

// Defines the undefined Kimen elements in `root` and watches the shadow
// root of each Kimen element it holds: components draw some children by name.
function search(root) {
  const pending = [];
  const visit = (element) => {
    if (!known(element)) return;
    if (customElements.get(element.localName) === undefined) {
      pending.push(define(element.localName).then(() => watch(element.shadowRoot)));
    } else {
      watch(element.shadowRoot);
    }
  };
  if (root.nodeType === 1) visit(root);
  for (const element of root.querySelectorAll('*')) visit(element);
  return Promise.all(pending);
}

function watch(root) {
  if (root === null || root === undefined || observed.has(root)) return Promise.resolve();
  observed.add(root);
  observer ??= new MutationObserver((records) => {
    for (const { addedNodes } of records) {
      for (const node of addedNodes) if (node.nodeType === 1) void search(node);
    }
  });
  observer.observe(root, { childList: true, subtree: true });
  return search(root);
}

export async function defineCustomElements(_win, options = {}) {
  if (typeof window === 'undefined') return undefined;
  excluded = new Set(options.exclude ?? []);
  await watch(document.documentElement);
}

export async function observeRoot(root) {
  if (typeof window === 'undefined') return undefined;
  await watch(root);
}
